license_required.quote: No person may engage for remuneration in dietetics and nutrition practice or nutrition counseling or hold himself or herself out as a practitioner of dietetics and nutrition practice or nutrition counseling unless the person is licensed in accordance with the provisions of this part.

degree_required.value: Baccalaureate or postbaccalaureate degree with a major course of study in human nutrition, food and nutrition, dietetics, or food management
degree_required.quote: Possesses a baccalaureate or postbaccalaureate degree with a major course of study in human nutrition, food and nutrition, dietetics, or food management, or an equivalent major course of study

accrediting_body.value: Commission on Recognition of Postsecondary Accreditation and the United States Department of Education
accrediting_body.quote: from a school or program accredited, at the time of the applicant's graduation, by the appropriate accrediting agency recognized by the Commission on Recognition of Postsecondary Accreditation and the United States Department of Education

required.quote: Has completed a preprofessional experience component of not less than 900 hours or has education or experience determined to be equivalent by the board

duration.quote: Has completed a preprofessional experience component of not less than 900 hours

kind.quote: "Preprofessional experience component" means a planned and continuous supervised practice experience in dietetics or nutrition.

exams.name: Licensure examination
exams.notes: Examination requirement is waived for applicants who are registered dietitians/registered dietitian-nutritionists with the Commission on Dietetic Registration, or certified nutrition specialists certified by the Certification Board for Nutrition Specialists, or Diplomates of the American Clinical Board of Nutrition.
exams.quote: Any person desiring to be licensed as a dietitian/nutritionist shall apply to the department to take the licensure examination.

interval_years.quote: The department shall adopt rules establishing a procedure for the biennial renewal of licenses under this part.

required.quote: The department shall renew a license under this part upon receipt of the renewal application, fee, and proof of the successful completion of continuing education requirements as determined by the board.

available.quote: The department shall issue a license to practice dietetics and nutrition by endorsement to any applicant who submits to background screening in accordance with s. 456.0135 and meets the requirements for licensure by endorsement under s. 456.0145

requirements.value: Must submit to background screening and meet requirements for licensure by endorsement under s. 456.0145, with completed application and fee.
requirements.quote: meets the requirements for licensure by endorsement under s. 456.0145, upon receipt of a completed application and the fee specified in s. 468.508.

exists.quote: There is created the Dietetics and Nutrition Practice Council under the supervision of the board.

name.quote: There is created the Dietetics and Nutrition Practice Council under the supervision of the board.

authority.value: The board may delegate such powers and duties to the council as it may deem proper to carry out the operations and procedures necessary to effectuate the provisions of this part.
authority.quote: The board may delegate such powers and duties to the council as it may deem proper to carry out the operations and procedures necessary to effectuate the provisions of this part.

national_certification.quote: "Commission" means the Commission on Dietetic Registration, the credentialing agency of the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics.

national_association.quote: "Commission" means the Commission on Dietetic Registration, the credentialing agency of the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics.

regulatory_model.quote: No person may engage for remuneration in dietetics and nutrition practice or nutrition counseling or hold himself or herself out as a practitioner of dietetics and nutrition practice or nutrition counseling unless the person is licensed in accordance with the provisions of this part.

credential_type.quote: No person may engage for remuneration in dietetics and nutrition practice or nutrition counseling or hold himself or herself out as a practitioner of dietetics and nutrition practice or nutrition counseling unless the person is licensed in accordance with the provisions of this part.

is_mandatory.quote: No person may engage for remuneration in dietetics and nutrition practice or nutrition counseling or hold himself or herself out as a practitioner of dietetics and nutrition practice or nutrition counseling unless the person is licensed in accordance with the provisions of this part.

title_protection.quote: Use the name or title "dietitian," "licensed dietitian," "nutritionist," "licensed nutritionist," "nutrition counselor," or "licensed nutrition counselor," or any other words, letters, abbreviations, or insignia indicating or implying that he or she is a dietitian, nutritionist, or nutrition counselor, or otherwise hold himself or herself out as such, unless the person is the holder of a valid license issued under this part

scope_protection.quote: No person may engage for remuneration in dietetics and nutrition practice or nutrition counseling or hold himself or herself out as a practitioner of dietetics and nutrition practice or nutrition counseling unless the person is licensed in accordance with the provisions of this part.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of this part, any board or department rule, or any lawful order or subpoena.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any provision of this part, any board or department rule adopted pursuant thereto, or any lawful order of the board or department previously entered in a disciplinary hearing held pursuant to this part, or failing to comply with a lawfully issued subpoena of the department.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being unable to engage in practice with reasonable skill and safety due to illness, substance use, or mental/physical condition.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being unable to engage in dietetics and nutrition practice or nutrition counseling with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of illness or use of alcohol, drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or any other type of material or as a result of any mental or physical condition.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Procuring or attempting to procure a license by fraud or material misrepresentation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Attempting to procure or procuring a license to practice dietetics and nutrition or nutrition counseling by fraud or material misrepresentation of material fact.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a license revoked, suspended, or otherwise acted against in another state, territory, or country.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having a license to practice dietetics and nutrition or nutrition counseling revoked, suspended, or otherwise acted against, including the denial of licensure by the licensing authority of another state, district, territory, or country.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted of or pleading nolo contendere to a crime directly related to the practice of dietetics or nutrition counseling.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted or found guilty of, or entering a plea of nolo contendere to, regardless of adjudication, a crime in any jurisdiction which directly relates to the practice of dietetics and nutrition or nutrition counseling or the ability to practice dietetics and nutrition or nutrition counseling.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or filing false reports or records, or impeding the filing of required records.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or filing a report or record that the licensee knows to be false, willfully failing to file a report or record required by state or federal law, willfully impeding or obstructing such filing, or inducing another person to impede or obstruct such filing.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising goods or services in a fraudulent, false, deceptive, or misleading manner.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising goods or services in a manner that is fraudulent, false, deceptive, or misleading in form or content.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing an act of fraud, deceit, negligence, incompetency, or misconduct in practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing an act of fraud or deceit, or of negligence, incompetency, or misconduct in the practice of dietetics and nutrition or nutrition counseling.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing with a revoked, suspended, inactive, or delinquent license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing with a revoked, suspended, inactive, or delinquent license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Treating or undertaking to treat human ailments by means other than dietetics and nutrition practice or nutrition counseling.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Treating or undertaking to treat human ailments by means other than by dietetics and nutrition practice or nutrition counseling.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to maintain acceptable standards of practice as set forth by the board and council.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to maintain acceptable standards of practice as set forth by the board and the council in rules adopted pursuant to this part.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in fee splitting, rebating, or receiving unearned commissions from patient referrals.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging directly or indirectly in the dividing, transferring, assigning, rebating, or refunding of fees received for professional services, or profiting by means of a credit or other valuable consideration, such as an unearned commission, discount, or gratuity, with any person referring a patient or with any relative or business associate of the referring person.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising experimental or scientifically unvalidated methods of assessment or treatment.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising, by or on behalf of a licensee under this part, any method of assessment or treatment which is experimental or without generally accepted scientific validation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of this chapter or chapter 456, or any rules adopted pursuant thereto.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any provision of this chapter or chapter 456, or any rules adopted pursuant thereto.

definition_quote.value: the integration and application of the principles derived from the sciences of nutrition, biochemistry, food, physiology, and management and from the behavioral and social sciences to achieve and maintain a person's health throughout the person's life
definition_quote.quote: "Dietetics" means the integration and application of the principles derived from the sciences of nutrition, biochemistry, food, physiology, and management and from the behavioral and social sciences to achieve and maintain a person's health throughout the person's life.

value: assessing nutrition needs and status using appropriate data
recommending appropriate dietary regimens, nutrition support, and nutrient intake
improving health status through nutrition research, counseling, and education
developing, implementing, and managing nutrition care systems
methods_authorized.quote: "Dietetics and nutrition practice" shall include assessing nutrition needs and status using appropriate data; recommending appropriate dietary regimens, nutrition support, and nutrient intake; ordering therapeutic diets; improving health status through nutrition research, counseling, and education; and developing, implementing, and managing nutrition care systems

license_type_structure.quote: "Licensed dietitian/nutritionist" means a person licensed pursuant to s. 468.509. "Licensed nutrition counselor" means a person licensed pursuant to s. 468.51.

provisional_license_available.quote: A temporary permit to practice dietetics and nutrition may be issued by the board on the filing of an application, payment of a temporary permit fee, and the submission of evidence of the successful completion of the educational requirement under s. 468.509.

provisional_license_duration_months.quote: A temporary permit shall expire 1 year from the date of issuance.

provisional_license_requires_supervision.quote: A person practicing under a temporary permit shall be under the supervision and direction of a licensed dietitian/nutritionist.

dietetic_technician_recognized.quote: "Dietetic technician" means a person who assists in the provision of dietetic and nutrition services under the supervision of a qualified professional.

rd_credential_accepted_in_lieu_of_state_.quote: The board shall waive the examination requirement for an applicant who presents evidence satisfactory to the board that the applicant is: (a) A registered dietitian or registered dietitian/nutritionist who is registered with the commission and complies with the qualifications under this section

value: Certified Nutrition Specialist (Certification Board for Nutrition Specialists)
Diplomate of the American Clinical Board of Nutrition
alternative_credential_pathways.quote: A certified nutrition specialist who is certified by the Certification Board for Nutrition Specialists or who is a Diplomate of the American Clinical Board of Nutrition and complies with the qualifications under this section.

diet_order_writing_authority.quote: This section does not preclude a licensed dietitian/nutritionist from independently ordering a therapeutic diet if otherwise authorized to order such a diet in this state.

physician_referral_required.quote: A licensee under this part shall not implement a dietary plan for a condition for which the patient is under the active care of a physician licensed under chapter 458 or chapter 459, without the oral or written dietary order of the referring physician.

diagnosis_treatment_prohibition.quote: Treating or undertaking to treat human ailments by means other than by dietetics and nutrition practice or nutrition counseling.

value: persons licensed under part I of chapter 464 (nursing)
persons licensed under chapter 491 (clinical social work, marriage and family therapy, and mental health counseling)
exempt_professions_list.quote: A person licensed in this state under chapter 457, chapter 458, chapter 459, chapter 460, chapter 461, chapter 462, chapter 463, part I of chapter 464, chapter 465, chapter 466, chapter 480, chapter 490, or chapter 491, when engaging in the profession or occupation for which he or she is licensed

federal_employee_exemption.quote: A person employed as a dietitian by the government of the United States, if the person engages in dietetics solely under direction or control of the organization by which the person is employed.

weight_control_program_exemption.quote: Any person who provides weight control services or related weight control products, provided the program has been reviewed by, consultation is available from, and no program change can be initiated without prior approval by a licensed dietitian/nutritionist, a dietitian or nutritionist licensed in another state that has licensure requirements considered by the council to be at least as stringent as the requirements for licensure under this part, or a registered dietitian.

food_supplement_sales_exemption.quote: A person who markets or distributes food, food materials, or dietary supplements, or any person who engages in the explanation of the use and benefits of those products or the preparation of those products, if that person does not engage for a fee in dietetics and nutrition practice or nutrition counseling.

nonresident_temporary_practice_allowed.quote: Any dietitian or nutritionist from another state practicing dietetics or nutrition incidental to a course of study when taking or giving a postgraduate course or other course of study in this state, provided such dietitian or nutritionist is licensed in another jurisdiction or is a registered dietitian or holds an appointment on the faculty of a school accredited pursuant to s. 468.509(3).

protected_titles.quote: Use the name or title "dietitian," "licensed dietitian," "nutritionist," "licensed nutritionist," "nutrition counselor," or "licensed nutrition counselor," or any other words, letters, abbreviations, or insignia indicating or implying that he or she is a dietitian, nutritionist, or nutrition counselor, or otherwise hold himself or herself out as such, unless the person is the holder of a valid license issued under this part

inactive_license_status_available.quote: A license under this part which has become inactive may be reactivated pursuant to this section.
